repository: Harvard Law School Library Historical & Special Collections
component_title: Lovejoy correspondence preserved on Pound Papers Reel 9
extent: at least 2 specifically cited Lovejoy letters
notes: Tiede cites Lovejoy to Pound 21 Oct 1913 and Lovejoy to Pound 14 Mar 1915 to Pound Papers Reel 9. Harvard's official finding aid confirms LAW.MMC.084 and explains that the 1986 microfilm reorganization altered Series I/IX and that the current online finding aid restored material to Series I. Current box/folder equivalents for the Reel-9 Lovejoy items therefore require an explicit microfilm-to-current crosswalk. Do not assume the 21 Oct 1913 letter is identical to the separately reported Hopkins Call copy.

other_party: Roscoe Pound; John Dewey; Edward Emerson Barnard; Ross Granville Harrison
column21: Tiede cites 1914.05.01 (05403) Lovejoy to Pound; 1914.05.15 (02649) Lovejoy to Dewey; 1914.11.17 (06424) Dewey and Lovejoy to Edward Emerson Barnard; and 1915.04.05? (03202) Lovejoy to Ross Granville Harrison in the Dewey Correspondence. SIU confirms that the Correspondence is an electronic editorial corpus built from photocopies/transcriptions of letters gathered from dispersed repositories; the Center is not an archive of the originals. These IDs are therefore powerful derivative locators but not original-custody locators.
